Subject: Access origins & authz artifacts — Clearwave intake and retention flags

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As part of our SIG/SOC 2 intake we need a small set of artefacts to validate access provenance and role ownership. Could you please provide the following: 

- SAML assertion samples (SP-initiated & IdP-initiated) for a few typical user sign-ins in October (preferably with timestamps and subject NameID).
- SCIM delta export covering 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-31 (adds/updates/deletes).
- A role-to-principal mapping snapshot (RBAC) as-of 2026-10-31, showing role names, attached permissions, and owner (email).
- Any service account mapping and justification notes (if service accounts were used with elevated roles).

Also: please indicate your recommended redaction plan for PII in the SAML samples (we want NameIDs masked but need consistent pseudonyms), and confirm retention window for these raw logs. We have an auditor checkpoint on 2026-11-10, so if possible wed like the files by 2026-11-05 EOD.

Attached is a small template for the mapping we prefer (requested_fields_template.xlsx) — use it to the extent it helps.

Thanks,

Jamie Ortiz
Security & Compliance
Clearwave Health

Jamie — thanks for the clear list. Plan below and a couple of clarifying questions so we deliver exactly what you need: 

1) What we'll deliver by 2026-11-05 EOD (deliverables):
   - SCIM delta file (CSV) with add/update/delete flags and timestamps for 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-31.
   - SAML assertion samples (XML) for 5 representative sessions (SP & IdP flows). We will pseudonymize NameIDs but keep stable hashes so you can tie events together.
   - RBAC snapshot (XLSX) matching your template; includes role owners and a short justification column for elevated roles.

2) Questions:
   - Confirm whether you want service account identifiers included in the main mapping or in a separate tab.
   - For SAML samples, we can remove full email addresses and replace with stable tokenized ids (e.g., user_XXXX). Is that acceptable to your auditor?

I'll loop in Marissa (platform lead) to generate the exports and Laura (legal/compliance) for retention guidance. If we hit any PII concerns we will raise them before delivery.

Ben / Jamie — delivering the artefacts requested. Notes on scope and redaction are below.

Files attached to this message (see Drive link below and attached stubs):
- scim-delta-snapshot-20261031.csv (CSV; rows: 12,421; columns: operation,timestamp,userId,externalId,email,displayName,groups)
- saml-assertion-sample.xml (ZIP of 5 XML files; NameIDs pseudonymized as stable-hashes)
- access-ownership-matrix-Q4.xlsx (RBAC snapshot + owner contact column)

Redaction / masking approach we used:
- Email addresses replaced with stable pseudonyms (user_8a3f). We kept a hashed mapping internally to support auditor reconciliation if needed under an NDA.
- Timestamps preserved in UTC; session durations included where available.
- Service accounts: included in the RBAC sheet as a distinct "service_account" principal type and flagged in the justification column.

Retention notes (short):
- Raw assertion copies are retained in our secure audit bucket for 90 days by default; SCIM deltas kept for 180 days. For audit purposes we can create a 1-year snapshot upon request (we'd need a signed request from an authorized security contact).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEk-Compliance (restricted: Clearwave + Redwood security roles)

If you need an unredacted mapping to run correlation with your logs we can discuss a controlled exchange (MFA+SLA + limited access window).

Thanks,
